About us

Small shop. Big heart.

The story behind Tami's Gaming Hub, and why we built it for this community.

Our Story

Tami's Gaming Hub began right here in Bagong Silang — a small room, a handful of PCs, and a simple goal: give neighbors an affordable place to game, study, and stay connected. What started small has grown into a space the whole community trusts.

Our Mission

To provide a clean, safe, and high-performance gaming and internet space that's genuinely affordable — so every student, gamer, and neighbor has somewhere reliable to go.

Our Vision

To be known as the most professional and welcoming computer shop in Bagong Silang — a brand-level experience, delivered with a neighborhood heart.

Business goals & community

Built for the block we grew up on.

We're not a franchise — we're your neighbors. Every upgrade we make, from faster internet to newer PCs, is guided by what our regulars actually need. We're committed to keeping rates fair, the space clean, and the environment safe enough for parents to feel comfortable sending their kids.

Our long-term goal is simple: grow alongside Bagong Silang, one satisfied customer at a time.

● Comfortable, community-first space

FAQs

Questions? We've got answers.

Everything you need to know before your visit.

Simply insert a coin into the reader at your station to start your session. The system counts down your remaining time on-screen, and you can add more coins anytime to keep playing.
Yes! Message us on Facebook or visit in person to reserve a station ahead of time, especially during peak hours and weekends.
Of course. You're welcome to bring your own headset, mouse, or keyboard if you have a personal favorite setup.
Light snacks and drinks are fine as long as the station stays clean. We just ask that you avoid messy meals near the equipment.
We support popular online and offline titles across genres — from MOBAs and shooters to casual browser games. Ask our staff for the current game list.
Our standard rate starts at ₱15 per hour, with discounted 2-hour, 3-hour, whole-day, student, and member rates. See our Rates section above for the full list.
